health_potion.name: Health Potion
health_potion.description: A vial of glowing crimson liquid that heals wounds.

potion_haste.name: Potion of Haste
potion_haste.description: A draft that makes time feel like it has slowed down.

scroll_identify.name: Scroll of Identify
scroll_identify.description: Reveals the magical properties of all items in your inventory.

food_ration.name: Smoked Venison Ration
food_ration.description: Durable frontier trail rations. Filling and nutritious.

apple.name: Crisp Apple
apple.description: Sweet, red, and fresh from the orchards.

rusty_sword.name: Rusty Iron Sword
rusty_sword.description: A pitted and nicked iron shortsword. Still dangerous.

iron_shield.name: Frontier Iron Shield
iron_shield.description: A heavy round shield bearing the crest of Shroudgarde.

iron_key.name: Sturdy Iron Key
iron_key.description: A heavy, cold-iron key. Fits standard chests and gates.

gold_key.name: Gilded Key
gold_key.description: An ornate brass key decorated with serpent engravings.

torch.name: Pine Torch
torch.description: A thick wooden torch wrapped in pitch-soaked cloth.

wand_of_lightning.name: Wand of Lightning
wand_of_lightning.description: A copper wand that unleashes arcs of lightning piercing enemies.

sacred_chalice.name: Sacred Chalice of Shroudgarde
sacred_chalice.description: An ancient vessel of power, stolen by the serpent cult. Warm to the touch.

cultist_journal.name: Serpent Cult Journal
cultist_journal.description: A notebook filled with hypnotic sigils and names of subverted villagers.

frontier_mead.name: Frontier Spiced Mead
frontier_mead.description: Bertram's signature spiced mead. Smells sweet, with a trace of almonds.

serpent_medallion.name: Serpent Medallion
serpent_medallion.description: A heavy copper medallion depicting a coiled snake eating its own tail. Crucial to open the swamp gate.

soul_gem.name: The Soul Gem of Inverness
soul_gem.description: A legendary jewel of pure force that absorbs light and life. Radiates high-intensity magic.

wand_of_fire.name: Wand of Fire
wand_of_fire.description: A magic wand that shoots a bolt of fire, stopping at the first enemy hit and igniting doors.

trident_of_tides.name: Trident of the Tides
trident_of_tides.description: An ancient, pearl-inlaid trident. Radiates raw elemental power over water and tides.

sluice_key.name: Hydrology Sluice Key
sluice_key.description: A massive, rust-covered iron key bearing water drop engravings. Fits the drainage valve.

lareth_staff.name: Staff of Lareth the Beautiful
lareth_staff.description: A beautiful, platinum-headed mace-staff carried by the dark cleric Lareth. Radiates healing and shielding forces.

fungal_potion.name: Fungal Spore Potion
fungal_potion.description: A vial containing the volatile spores of Zuggtmoy. Throwing it releases a choking cloud of poison gas.
